features.name: Telepathy

effects.note: You learn the telepathy spell, which you can cast without a spell slot at 2nd, 8th, 14th and 18th level. Creatures that aren't undead or constructs and have an Intelligence of 3 or lower are unaffected.

features.summary: Learn telepathy; cast it without a slot four times
features.text: You learn the telepathy spell, which you can cast at will without a spell slot.

source.reference: Mordenkainen's Tome of Foes Aberrant Mind 1

features.name: Psionic Spells

effects.note: You can take the Prepared spell option and prepare spells from the psionic list of the Psychic Handlers source, swapping them whenever you finish a long rest. The list is 1st through 9th level, two spells per level at 1st through 4th and three per level from 5th.

features.summary: Prepare from the psionic list, two per level to 4th, three after
features.text: You can take the Prepared spell option and prepare spells from the psionic list of the Psychic Handlers source.

source.reference: Mordenkainen's Tome of Foes Aberrant Mind 1

features.name: Psychic Deflection

effects.note: You gain a +1 bonus to AC while you have telepathy. When you are damaged by an attack, you can use your reaction to reduce the damage to 1, and at 16th level the reduction is 1d10 psychic damage. You regain the use after a long rest.
The reduction is 1d10 psychic damage instead of 1.

features.summary: Reaction: reduce one attack's damage to 1 (1d10 at 16)
features.text: When you are damaged by an attack, you can use your reaction to reduce the damage to 1. You regain the use of this after a long rest.

source.reference: Mordenkainen's Tome of Foes Aberrant Mind 6

features.name: Revelation in Flesh

effects.note: When you cast a spell of 2nd level or higher, you can make one melee weapon attack as part of the same action, using Strength or Dexterity. You can use this a number of times equal to 1 plus your Charisma modifier, and at 18th level two extra times, regaining all on a long rest.
You can use this two additional times.

features.summary: Cast a 2nd-level+ spell and also make a melee attack
features.text: When you cast a spell of 2nd level or higher, you can make one melee weapon attack as part of the same action.

source.reference: Mordenkainen's Tome of Foes Aberrant Mind 14

features.name: Warping Implosion

effects.note: Whenever you cast a spell that would target only you, you can instead have it target every creature within 120 feet of you. If a creature takes this spell's damage, you can teleport as a bonus action to a space you can see within 60 feet of it, and take any of its hit dice as temporary hit points equal to half that many. At the end of each of your turns, you lose any temporary hit points taken this way.

features.summary: Self-targeting spells hit everyone within 120 ft; then teleport and steal HP
features.text: Whenever you cast a spell that would target only you, you can instead have it target every creature within 120 feet of you.

source.reference: Mordenkainen's Tome of Foes Aberrant Mind 18

features.name: Clockwork Magic

effects.note: You know the mage hand cantrip, which you can cast at will without a spell slot. You can also cast magic missile, and know the shield spell, always prepared. At 6th level you cast the spells as 3rd level; at 12th 6th; at 18th 9th.

features.summary: Mage hand at will, plus magic missile and shield
features.text: You know the mage hand cantrip, which you can cast at will, and the magic missile and shield spells.

source.reference: Mordenkainen's Tome of Foes Clockwork Soul 1

features.name: Restore Balance

effects.note: You learn the sanctuary spell, which you can cast without a spell slot, and it ends the blinded and charmed conditions on the target as well as healing 1d8 plus your Intelligence modifier. At 6th level the healing is 2d8, at 12th 3d8, and at 18th 4d8.

features.summary: Learn sanctuary; cast it without a slot to heal and decondition
features.text: You learn the sanctuary spell, which you can cast without a spell slot. It ends the blinded and charmed conditions on the target as well as healing.

source.reference: Mordenkainen's Tome of Foes Clockwork Soul 1

features.name: Bastion of Law

effects.note: When you cast a spell, you can spend 1 sorcery point to give one creature within 60 feet that you can see advantage on its next attack roll or saving throw, and you regain a point when a creature you targeted with this finishes a short or long rest. At 17th level the benefit also applies to allies within 10 feet.

features.summary: Spend 1 sorcery point to give a creature advantage on a roll
features.text: When you cast a spell, you can spend 1 sorcery point to give one creature within 60 feet that you can see advantage on its next attack roll or saving throw.

source.reference: Mordenkainen's Tome of Foes Clockwork Soul 6

features.name: Trance of Order

effects.note: You can use a bonus action to hold yourself in a trance for 1 minute, during which you are conscious, and the next time you finish a long rest you can use this to gain the benefit twice, once for this trance and once as your long-rest trance. You also gain a +1 bonus to Wisdom saving throws.

features.summary: Bonus action: 1-minute trance; +1 to Wisdom saves
features.text: You can use a bonus action to hold yourself in a trance for 1 minute, during which you are conscious.

source.reference: Mordenkainen's Tome of Foes Clockwork Soul 14

features.name: Clockwork Cavalcade

effects.note: When you cast any spell at 2nd level or higher, you can summon a Large or smaller creature whose challenge rating is equal to 2 or lower, and at 10th level equal to 10 or lower. It takes its turn after you, and you can give it simple commands with your action, and it vanishes at the end of your next turn.

features.summary: Casting 2nd+ summons a CR 2 construct to fight beside you
features.text: When you cast any spell at 2nd level or higher, you can summon a Large or smaller creature whose challenge rating is equal to 2 or lower.

source.reference: Mordenkainen's Tome of Foes Clockwork Soul 18

features.name: Bonus Proficiency

effects.note: You gain proficiency in a skill or tool of your choice. You are also proficient with two extra languages of your choice, and your Charisma score is increased by 1.

features.summary: Proficiency in a skill, a tool, and two extra languages
features.text: You gain proficiency in a skill or tool of your choice.

features.name: Favored by the Gods

effects.note: When you gain this feature, you also learn a domain spell from a divine domain of your choice, and you gain the associated Domain Spells feature. Your domain spells are always prepared and don't count against your prepared spells. The effect improves by 1 at 6th, 12th and 18th level.

features.summary: Learn a domain's spell and its Domain Spells feature
features.text: When you gain this feature, you also learn a domain spell from a divine domain of your choice, and you gain the associated Domain Spells feature.

features.name: Empowered Healing

effects.note: You can expend a spell slot of any level to cast one of the domain or cleric cantrips you know, on yourself or a creature within 10 feet, without material components, ending the target's exhaustion as well as healing. It also removes the poisoned and frightened conditions.

features.summary: Spend a slot to cast a domain cantrip and heal, without components
features.text: You can expend a spell slot of any level to cast one of the domain or cleric cantrips you know, on yourself or a creature within 10 feet, without material components.

features.name: Otherworldly Wings

effects.note: You gain a flight speed equal to your walking speed, for 1 minute, and this ends early if you are wearing medium or heavier armor, are encumbered or incapacitated, or use a shield.

features.summary: Bonus action: flight for a minute, once per long rest
features.text: You gain a flight speed equal to your walking speed for 1 minute. This ends early if you are wearing medium or heavier armor, are encumbered or incapacitated, or use a shield.

features.name: Unnerving Defense

trigger.note: When a creature you can see within 30 feet of you fails a saving throw.

effects.note: When a creature you can see within 30 feet of you fails a saving throw, you can use your reaction to impose disadvantage on its next attack roll, and the effect ends at the end of your next turn.

features.summary: Reaction: allies' failed saves give advantage against the attacker
features.text: When a creature you can see within 30 feet of you fails a saving throw, you can use your reaction to impose disadvantage on its next attack roll.

features.name: Dragon Ancestor

effects.note: At 1st level, you choose a type of dragon ancestry, and the damage type and breath weapon come from that type, as do your resistance and the bonus HP.

features.summary: Choose your draconic ancestry: its type sets your damage
features.text: At 1st level, you choose a type of dragon ancestry, which gives you a special breath weapon and resistance to its damage type.

features.name: Draconic Resilience

effects.note: Your hit point maximum increases by 1, and by 1 again whenever you gain a level, as long as you have a draconic ancestry and this trait. You also have resistance to the damage type of your ancestry.

features.summary: An extra hit point per level, and ancestry damage resistance
features.text: Your hit point maximum increases by 1, and by 1 again whenever you gain a level. You also have resistance to the damage type of your ancestry.

features.name: Elemental Affinity

effects.note: You gain resistance to the damage type of your ancestry and can add your Charisma modifier to a damage roll for a spell you cast, and if you cast a cantrip with that damage type, you can cast it as a bonus action. At 16th level this works with all your spells, not just cantrips.
This works with any of your spells, not just cantrips, and you can cast them as a bonus action.

features.summary: Add Cha to ancestry-type spell damage; cantrips become bonus actions
features.text: You gain resistance to the damage type of your ancestry and can add your Charisma modifier to a damage roll for a spell you cast.

features.name: Dragon Wings

effects.note: You gain a flight speed equal to your walking speed for 1 minute, and this ends early if you are wearing medium or heavier armor, are encumbered or incapacitated, or use a shield.

features.summary: Bonus action: flight for a minute, once per long rest
features.text: You gain a flight speed equal to your walking speed for 1 minute.

features.name: Draconic Presence

effects.note: You can use an action to unleash a shocking burst of energy in a 30-foot cube, and each creature in it makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 3d6 force damage and failing to use reactions on a failure or half damage and no reaction loss on a success. At 20th level the area is a 60-foot cone and there is no save on a critical.
The area is a 60-foot cone instead of a cube, and a creature that takes this damage with a critical hit doesn't make the saving throw.

features.summary: Action: 3d6 force in a 30-ft cube, costing reactions
features.text: You can use an action to unleash a shocking burst of energy in a 30-foot cube. Each creature in the area makes a Constitution saving throw, taking 3d6 force damage.

features.name: Eyes of the Dark

effects.note: You know the darkness spell, which you can cast at will without a spell slot, and it lasts 1 hour, longer if it is cast at a higher level. At 6th and 16th level, if a spell you cast requires concentration, you do not have to concentrate on it.

tiers.summary: One spell per turn needs no concentration
A second spell per turn needs no concentration

features.summary: Darkness at will; some concentration spells become free
features.text: You know the darkness spell, which you can cast at will without a spell slot, and it lasts 1 hour.

features.name: Strength of the Grave

effects.note: Your spells can deal necrotic damage. When you reduce a creature to 0 hit points with one of those spells, its hit point maximum is lowered by an amount equal to the necrotic damage dealt. At 6th and 16th level you can cast the thaumaturgy cantrip without a spell slot.
You can cast thaumaturgy without a spell slot.
You can cast thaumaturgy without a spell slot, and you gain an additional darkvision range of 60 feet.

features.summary: Spells deal necrotic; killing one lowers its max HP
features.text: Your spells can deal necrotic damage. When you reduce a creature to 0 hit points with one of those spells, its hit point maximum is lowered.

features.name: Hound of Ill Omen

effects.note: When you cast the find familiar spell, you can instead conjure a phantom watchdog in an unoccupied space you can see within 30 feet. It is a Small spectral creature, invisible to all creatures except you and can't be harmed, and if an effect would damage it, the effect instead ends. It has a flying speed of 40 feet, a +4 bonus to attack rolls, 1d8 piercing damage on a hit, and a Wisdom save or it is frightened until the end of the next turn.

features.summary: Bonus action: a spectral watchdog that acts on its own turn
features.text: When you cast the find familiar spell, you can instead conjure a phantom watchdog in an unoccupied space you can see within 30 feet of you.

features.name: Shadow Walk

effects.note: When you are in dim light or darkness, you can use a bonus action to become invisible, teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see, and be surrounded by dim light. The light ends at the start of your next turn, and the effect ends if you are in sunlight.

features.summary: Bonus action: become invisible and teleport 30 ft in dim light
features.text: When you are in dim light or darkness, you can use a bonus action to become invisible, teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see, and be surrounded by dim light.

features.name: Umbral Form

effects.note: You can use a bonus action to become a shadow for 1 minute, gaining resistance to all damage except force, advantage on Dex saves, and a bonus action each turn to teleport up to 30 feet, which ends the form if you do. The form ends early if you are in sunlight or cast a spell.

features.summary: Bonus action: a shadow form for a minute, with a free teleport each turn
features.text: You can use a bonus action to become a shadow for 1 minute, gaining resistance to all damage except force, advantage on Dex saves, and a bonus action each turn to teleport up to 30 feet.

features.name: Wind Speaker

effects.note: You have resistance to lightning damage, and you can cast the gust of wind cantrip at will without a spell slot, with the effect increasing at 6th, 11th and 16th level. At 6th level you gain a +1 bonus to hit points and one other 6th-level sorcerer origin feature.

tiers.summary: +1 hit point and another origin feature

features.summary: Gust of wind at will; lightning resistance
features.text: You have resistance to lightning damage, and you can cast the gust of wind cantrip at will without a spell slot.

features.name: Tempestuous Magic

effects.note: You can use a bonus action to cause a small thunderstorm to form around you. The storm lasts 1 minute, is centered on you, moves with you, and consists of a 10-foot radius sphere of dim light. Each creature that enters the storm's area for the first time on a turn makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking 1d6 thunder damage on a failure and half on a success.

features.summary: Bonus action: a 10-ft storm around you, 1d6 on entry
features.text: You can use a bonus action to cause a small thunderstorm to form around you. Each creature that enters the storm's area for the first time on a turn makes a Dexterity saving throw, taking thunder damage.

features.name: Heart of the Storm

effects.note: You gain resistance to lightning damage, and you gain a +1 bonus to hit points and an AC bonus of 1 for every 6 sorcerer levels you have. When the Tempestuous Magic feature is used, you regain 1d8 + 3 hit points.

features.summary: Lightning resistance, +1 HP and AC per 6 levels, storm heals you
features.text: You gain resistance to lightning damage. You also gain a bonus to your hit point maximum and an AC bonus equal to 1 for every 6 sorcerer levels you have.

features.name: Storm Guide

effects.note: When a creature attacks you and has more than 20 feet between it and you, you can use your reaction to impose disadvantage on the attack roll, and the Tempestuous Magic feature is active, and the rest of your turn, until you next cast a spell, and it ends if you are incapacitated, killed or use a dash or disengage.

features.summary: Reaction: attackers more than 20 ft away have disadvantage
features.text: When a creature attacks you and has more than 20 feet between it and you, you can use your reaction to impose disadvantage on the attack roll.

features.name: Storm's Fury

effects.note: When a creature within 60 feet that you can see of you is hit by your Tempestuous Magic feature, you can use your bonus action to deal 2d10 lightning damage to it, and at 18th level 4d10. You regain the use when you finish a long rest.
4d10 lightning damage instead of 2d10.

features.summary: Bonus action: 2d10 lightning when your storm hits something
features.text: When a creature within 60 feet of you that you can see is hit by your Tempestuous Magic feature, you can use your bonus action to deal 2d10 lightning damage to it.

features.name: Wind Soul

effects.note: You gain a fly speed of 60 feet, and you can use a reaction to become invisible until the end of your next turn, and when you cast a spell that targets only you, you can target every creature within 5 feet of you instead. At 20th level this becomes 30 feet.
The radius for spells that target only you becomes 30 feet.

features.summary: Fly 60 ft; reaction to be invisible; self-targets hit those nearby
features.text: You gain a fly speed of 60 feet, and you can use a reaction to become invisible until the end of your next turn.

features.name: Wild Magic Surge

effects.note: Your magic is fueled by power beyond your own. When you cast a spell, you can expend a Wild Magic Surge and reroll the d20 determining the spell's effect. If the new roll is lower, it has no effect and you regain the surge.

features.summary: Reroll a spell's effect d20 at the cost of your surge
features.text: Your magic is fueled by power beyond your own. When you cast a spell, you can expend a Wild Magic Surge and reroll the d20 determining the spell's effect.

features.name: Tides of Chaos

effects.note: When you or a creature within 60 feet that you can see that you can target with a spell makes an attack roll, you can use your reaction to add 2d12 force damage to the attack, and the spell takes effect. You can use this once per turn, and you regain the use when you finish a long rest.

features.summary: Reaction: add 2d12 force to a spell's attack that hits
features.text: When you or a creature within 60 feet of you that you can see that you can target with a spell makes an attack roll, you can use your reaction to add 2d12 force damage to the attack, and the spell takes effect.

features.name: Bend Luck

effects.note: You can use your reaction to choose a creature within 60 feet that you can see, and you gain advantage on the next saving throw it makes, and disadvantage on its next attack roll. The creature is unaffected if the roll is 20, and the effect ends at the end of your next turn. You regain the use when you finish a long rest.

features.summary: Reaction: give a creature disadvantage on attacks, advantage on saves
features.text: You can use your reaction to choose a creature within 60 feet of you that you can see, and you gain advantage on the next saving throw it makes, and disadvantage on its next attack roll.

features.name: Controlled Chaos

effects.note: When you roll an 8 or lower for a Wild Magic Surge's effect, you gain a Tides of Chaos surge, which lets you reroll the triggering d20. If the new roll is also 8 or lower, the spell fails. You have a number of Wild Magic Surges equal to twice your sorcerer level, and you regain all on a short or long rest.

features.summary: Double low surge becomes a free reroll and a failed spell
features.text: When you roll an 8 or lower for a Wild Magic Surge's effect, you gain a Tides of Chaos surge, which lets you reroll the triggering d20.

features.name: Spell Bombardment

effects.note: Whenever you cast a spell, you can use a bonus action to make one melee spell attack, which is a separate action and does not count against the one-spell-per-turn limit, and can be as a reaction on a miss with Controlled Chaos. It does not retrigger Controlled Chaos, and you gain a +1 bonus to the damage roll and the DC to save it.

features.summary: Every spell you cast also grants a bonus-action spell attack
features.text: Whenever you cast a spell, you can use a bonus action to make one melee spell attack.
